append_law: new commits must be descendants of the current ledger head; force updates and deletions are forbidden
source_binding_law: one GitHub issue path permanently binds its first accepted application digest and issue-body digest
idempotence_law: an identical source binding and identical content-addressed objects produce no new commit
collision_law: an occupied path with different bytes is a fail-closed conflict
replay_law: one application digest may have multiple source observations but never becomes multiple candidates
aggregation_law: global uniqueness and independence are evaluated symmetrically over one fixed ledger tree; streaming first-writer status is non-authoritative
